name: @example/computer-celld
description: Prototype @cloudflare/computer Workspace running on celld with a local S3-compatible shim.

scripts.deploy:local: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local AWS_REGION=us-east-1 celld deploy . --bucket s3://celld-computer --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:9000 --region us-east-1
scripts.celld:local: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local AWS_REGION=us-east-1 CELLD_WORKER_LOADER=LOADER CELLD_WATCH=.celld-state celld --bucket s3://celld-computer --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:9000 --region us-east-1 --listen 127.0.0.1:8080 --advertise 127.0.0.1:8080
